title: PatchVerifierResult
description: Verdict from the patch verifier. Enforced natively by runtimes that support structured output (claude-code --json-schema, codex --output-schema); parse-and-repair is used only for runtimes that do not.

pass.description: Whether the implementation matches the spec. NOTE: the workflow does not trust this field on its own — a true value alongside a non-empty issues list is downgraded to needs_review.

issues.description: Specific, actionable problems. Empty when pass is true.
